verdict.rationale: Trello's own site lists a first-party "MCP server" that lets you "Connect Trello to any AI tool", so an official MCP server for connecting agents is claimed. The evidence is only a single marketing-level mention. Missing for 10: setup/connection documentation, a list of exposed tools or capabilities, auth and permission details for the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect and act on boards.
